# PhysxAutoDeformableHexahedralMeshAPI

Makes the automatic cook of a volume deformable build a hexahedral (voxel) simulation mesh that embeds the collision tetrahedral mesh. Listing the API is what enables it; it is read only for a volume body that also lists PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Requires on the same prim:** [`PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI`](PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI.md), [`OmniPhysicsDeformableBodyAPI`](OmniPhysicsDeformableBodyAPI.md)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## What USD population writes

Published like any applied physics API: every declared attribute at its resolved value. No column is rewritten or created by the producer.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physxDeformableBody:resolution` | uint32 | none | 0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0 | 0: the cooker uses 10 hexahedral elements along the longest edge. Authored values from 1 to 3 are raised to 4. |

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI`](PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI.md):** Read only inside the PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI read and only for a volume body (simulation mesh with OmniPhysicsVolumeDeformableSimAPI); a surface body ignores the API.
